name: @srdjan/avatar
//imports: Deno has no devDependencies: everything here becomes a declared dependency of every consumer. Test-only packages use full specifiers inside tests/ instead.
//fmt: The generated classic script is excluded: its bytes are the esbuild output verbatim, so formatting it here would assert a second, unpinned contract over a SHA-256-locked file.
//lint: This package does not adopt Light FP lint. A consumer workspace that loads the plugin at its root also applies it to this member, and a member cannot drop an inherited plugin, so the exclude list names every plugin rule. Without the plugin, Deno ignores these names.

tasks.type: deno check mod.ts server/mod.ts assets/mod.ts browser/runtime_core.ts browser/facial_rig.ts tools/build_facial_rig.ts tools/package_integrity.ts tools/runtime_metrics.ts tests/unit_test.ts tests/runtime_unit_test.ts tests/contract_test.ts tests/browser_test.ts
tasks.browser: deno task playwright:install && deno test -A tests/browser_test.ts
tasks.browser:coverage: deno task browser:check && deno task playwright:install && AVATAR_BROWSER_COVERAGE=1 deno test -A tests/browser_test.ts
tasks.check: deno task browser:check && deno task browser:metrics && deno task package:integrity && deno task fmt && deno task lint && deno task type && deno task unit && deno task browser && deno task consumer
